Fields.url: Path after the address of the connection
Fields.maxViewportFeatures: At most this many features in the view

Hints.connection: A REST connection whose address is the service, e.g. https://gdi.berlin.de/services/wfs/baumbestand
Hints.url: Empty where the service is at the address of the connection.
Hints.outputFormat: Empty: GeoJSON. A service without it answers GML, which is read too.
Hints.filter: Where the service supports CQL. Empty: no filter.
Hints.mode: WMS GetFeatureInfo is for a QGIS Server that offers the layer as WMS only; it needs a box and reads it in tiles.

IWfsStoreConfiguration.extent: What the map shows: a map on this source sends its view, and only the tiles in it are read, each once. Without a map: the box below.
IWfsStoreConfiguration.tileSize: The edge of a tile in degrees of latitude (longitude in proportion); one request per tile.
IWfsStoreConfiguration.minZoom: Further out nothing is read; the view would have too many tiles.
IWfsStoreConfiguration.maxViewportFeatures: At most this many features in the view, those of the tiles near the middle first; 0: no limit.

Settings.noTypes: The service lists no feature type.
Settings.noWfs: This address answers no WFS GetCapabilities.
Settings.unreachable: The service cannot be reached, or does not allow the board to read it (CORS).
Settings.readColumns: Read the column types from the service (DescribeFeatureType)
Settings.noColumns: The service describes no columns of this feature type.

Preview.failed: The service answered with an error: {{message}}
